Négy emelkedő, négy támadás, ez a versen: Four climbs, four attacks; this race-like work was strong, a beautiful performance.

Hat kör és a hajrá, ezt a versenyhelyzet: Six laps and the finish; you handled this race situation well. Bring your heart rate down slowly.
Ismételt támadások, üldözések és visszaz: Handling repeated attacks, chases and regrouping

Könnyebb szakasz, a mellkasod legyen nyi: An easier section; keep your chest open and your breathing calm.

Harmadik támadás. Most mutasd meg, mit b: Third attack. Show what you can do in a short, sharper burst.

A turn on the front, hard.

A calm build-up; no need to hurry.

Kb. 90%-os erőfeszítés, nem teljes erő;: About a 90% effort, not full; the aim is waking up.

Félidő, most a lábad emlékezzen a tempór: Halfway; let your legs remember the pace and keep your breathing deep.
Második sprint előtt pihenés, a légzésed: Rest before the second sprint; let your breathing settle and get ready.
Utolsó tíz másodperc, élesen, aztán vége: The last ten seconds, sharply, then the opener is over.

It can also serve as a warm-up before short races (crit, time trial).

Az utolsó emelés az FTP-n, utána már csa: The last lift at FTP; after it only the short sprints come.
Második sprint, rövid és éles. Csak a lé: Second sprint, short and sharp. Just steer your breathing.
Három emelés és három sprint, ez a rövid: Three lifts and three sprints; this short session was serious work too. Ease off slowly and look back satisfied.
Időfutam-adagolás: visszafogott kezdés,: Time-trial pacing: a restrained start, a strong finish
Negyven perc időfutam-tempó három szakas: Forty minutes of time-trial pace in three sections: ten minutes at 95%, twenty at 98%, then ten at 100–103% with the last two minutes a free finale. Time trials are most often ruined by starting too fast; the session teaches negative-split pacing. If you have a time-trial position, ride in it.
A mai feladat a visszafogott kezdés és a: Today's task is the restrained start and the strong end. Keep the patience in the warm-up.
Two short lifts before the start.

Second short lift, then the start comes. Do not spend energy now.
Egy perc van a rajtig. Vegyél mély leveg: One minute to the start. Take a deep breath, keep your shoulders loose.
The first ten minutes should feel too easy. Good.
Ne figyelj a többiekre, csak a 95%-os te: Do not watch the others, just hold your 95% pace; you will need the strength at the end.
Egyenletes, pozícióban; csak a következő: Steady, in position; watch only the next minute.

Utolsó perc a középszakaszból, már közel: Last minute of the middle section; the strong finish is close.
Lift; from here you do not need to save anything.
Félúton a befejezésben, a fordulat legye: Halfway through the finish; make the revs quicker and keep your hips stable.
Az utolsó két perc szabad: told ki, amen: The last two minutes are free: push out whatever is left.

Támadás után a szökés megtartása a küszö: Holding the breakaway near the threshold after an attack

A breakaway is not decided by the attack but by holding the following minutes while the lactate is still high. This session practises exactly that painful transition.
A szökés-szimuláció a támadás utáni tart: The breakaway simulation is about holding after the attack; the warm-up now prepares your legs.
Öt perc van hátra, készülj, hogy az első: Five minutes left; get ready, because after the first attack you cannot ease off.
Egy perc teljes lendülettel, hogy elszak: One minute at full momentum, to get away.
Azonnal vissza 95%-ra: az első két perc: Straight back to 95%: the first two minutes are the hardest, do not give in.
Félidő a szökésben, a csípőd nyugodt leg: Halfway through the breakaway; keep your hips quiet and the cadence around 90.
Egy perc van hátra, ne engedd el a tempó: One minute left; do not let the pace go, the bunch will not catch you now.
Első szökés kész, a pihenőben a légzésed: First breakaway done; in the rest let your breathing settle, the second attack comes.
Második támadás, indulj erősen, aztán fo: Second attack; start hard, then settle back to the same pace.
Félúton a második szökésben, a tempó mar: Halfway through the second breakaway; keep the pace around 95 and do not let your legs relax.
Utolsó támadás, most mindent bele egy pe: Last attack; give everything for a minute, then hold the pace.
Az utolsó tartás, a fejedben a cél egyér: The last hold; your goal is clear, keep your exhale strong.
Egy perc van hátra, a végére se lassulj,: One minute left; do not slow down at the end, because that is the point of a breakaway.
Három támadás, három tartás, a szökés-sz: Three attacks, three holds; the breakaway simulation builds staying power, nice work.

A short, steep ramp: standing, hard.
Tempo on the gravel; not a rest.
Másfél perc van hátra, tartsd a 80%-ot,: Ninety seconds left; hold the 80% and do not let go of the bars.
Hullámzó szakasz: a watt hol emelkedik,: A rolling section: the watts rise and fall. Keep your breathing even.

Egy perc van hátra az utolsó egyenesből,: One minute left of the last straight; give a little more at the end.
A kavics, a dombok és az egyenesek után: After the gravel, the hills and the straights you can finally relax. Bring your heart rate down slowly; nice work.

Valaki meglódult az élen: zárj rá, aztán: Someone went off the front: close it, then back to tempo.
Bunch pace at the boundary of zones 2 and 3.

Még majdnem három perc, a légzésed kezdj: Almost three minutes more; let your breathing start to slow.

Itt már ismerős a tempó, de a kadenciára: The pace is familiar by now, but keep watching the cadence.

Az utolsó mezőny jön, figyelj a kadenciá: The last bunch comes; watch the cadence, then the easy part follows.
A mezőnyben végig tartottad a helyed, so: You held your place in the bunch all the way, even after many accelerations. Nice work; relax now.

FTP is 95% of the 20-minute average power; the five-minute effort before it takes the edge off your freshness, so the 20-minute number lands closer to hour power. In the test sections the trainer is in free mode: you pace. After the test the Review → Power page offers the new FTP from your best 20 minutes (calculated from measured watts only).
Ez az FTP-teszt, a mai cél a pontos méré: This is the FTP test; today's goal is an accurate measurement, and the warm-up now prepares your legs.
Tíz perc van hátra, a légzésed legyen ny: Ten minutes left; keep your breathing calm and the cadence around 85.
Két perc, és jön az első rövid ébresztés: Two minutes and the first short wake-up comes; do not tire yourself beforehand.
Utolsó pörgetés a nyitás előtt, most a f: Last spin before the opener; keep the revs high, then rest.
Most jön a rövid, erős nyitás, a pihenő: The short, strong opener comes now; in the rest let your breathing settle.
Erősen, de ne a teljes kimerülésig; ez n: Hard, but not to complete exhaustion; this is the opener.
Félidő, ülj le és tarts egyenletes erőt,: Halfway; sit down and hold an even force, do not accelerate too early.
Öt perc van hátra, a légzésed nyugodjon,: Five minutes left; let your breathing calm, and take a sip before the main test.
Kezdj visszafogottan, a második tíz perc: Start restrained, lift in the second ten minutes; the last two minutes at full effort.
Öt perc ment, most ellenőrizd, hogy a te: Five minutes in; check now that the pace is even.
Félidő, most ülj egyenesen, a légzésed l: Halfway; sit up straight, keep your breathing deep and the cadence around 90.
Egy perc van hátra, most minden maradéko: One minute left; put every last bit in.

Az FTP becslése két nyolcperces erőfeszí: Estimating FTP with two eight-minute efforts

Shorter sections are easier to pace well, so it is more reliable than the twenty-minute test for beginners too; FTP is estimated as about 90% of the better of the two 8-minute averages. In the test sections the trainer is in free mode.
Félúton a bemelegítésben. A mai teszt az: Halfway through the warm-up. Today's test builds on estimating FTP; do not tire yourself now.
Két perc van hátra a bemelegítésből, kés: Two minutes left of the warm-up; get ready for the short spins.
Half a minute left, then the rest comes. Breathe deeply and keep your legs turning.
Második rövid pörgetés. Ez a bemelegítés: Second short spin. This is the last sharp moment of the warm-up; just let your legs spin.
Két és fél perc van hátra a pihenőből. L: Two and a half minutes left of the rest. Breathe deeply; before the test the heart rate has to come down.
Erős, egyenletes kezdés; az utolsó percb: A strong, even start; give everything in the last minute.

Egy perc van hátra az első tesztből, tar: One minute left of the first test; keep the cadence around 92.

Ugyanaz a stratégia; jó, ha az elsőnél n: The same strategy; it is good if this one is not weaker than the first.
Félúton. Tartsd ugyanazt a tempót, mint: Halfway. Keep the same pace as the first and your breathing steady.
Két nyolcperces erőfeszítés, ez az FTP-d: Two eight-minute efforts; this is the basis of your FTP estimate. Bring your heart rate down slowly; nice work.

About 75% of the last complete minute's average gives the FTP estimate. Short, easy to repeat, with little room for pacing error; for the average rider this is the default test. Stop when you can no longer hold the cadence.
A ramp teszt a fokozatos emelésről szól,: The ramp test is about the gradual rise; do not tire yourself yet.
Három perc egyenletesen, majd indul a lé: Three minutes steady, then the steps start.
Másfél perc van a tesztig, a pozíciódat: A minute and a half to the test; fix your position now.
Minden percben +20 W. Tartsd a kadenciát: Plus 20 W every minute. Hold the cadence as long as you can; when it is gone, the test is over.
A teszt közepén vagy, a légzésed legyen: You are in the middle of the test; keep your breathing deep and even.

Három perc van hátra, készülj, hogy a ra: Three minutes left; get ready, the ramp starts soon.
A ramp előtt egy kis lendület, a kadenci: A little momentum before the ramp; keep the cadence around 95 and your legs turning.
Plus 15 W every minute, to exhaustion.
Ötödik perc, a légzésed legyen ritmusos,: Fifth minute; keep your breathing rhythmic and the cadence around 90.
Tíz perc, a felsőtested maradjon lazán,: Ten minutes; keep your upper body loose and your hands from tensing on the bars.
Még körülbelül öt perc, figyeld a légzés: About five minutes more; watch your breathing and do not fall out of the rhythm.
Egy perc van hátra, ha már nem bírod, ny: One minute left; if you cannot hold it, slow down calmly, you still get the test result.
A mért eredményed most már jó alap a köv: Your measured result is a good basis for the coming sessions now; nice work.
Gyorsabb ramp teszt erősebb bringásoknak: A quicker ramp test for stronger riders

The shorter test is less tiring, so maximal aerobic power can be measured more accurately. The FTP estimate is about 75% of the last complete minute.

Három perc egyenletesen, a kadenciát 95-: Three minutes steady, keep the cadence at 95. This is the last calm section before the test.
Plus 25 W every minute, to exhaustion.

In the longer steps oxygen uptake and heart rate can settle, so it is closer to the classic MAP protocol used in laboratories, and it can also be used to set heart rate zones. Longer and harder than a per-minute ramp.
A bemelegítés most a fejedet készíti elő: The warm-up now prepares your head. Today brings steady, longer steps.

Most már érezhetően nehezebb, a vállad m: It is noticeably harder now; keep your shoulders loose and your hips stable.
Még két perc a tesztből, tartsd a fordul: Two more minutes of the test; hold the revs as long as you can.

According to Karsten et al., multi-point field CP tests are valid and reliable. Both sections in free mode, evenly paced.

One minute at FTP, a wake-up.
Egy perc pihenő, a légzésed nyugodjon, a: One minute of rest; let your breathing calm, then the second short wake-up comes.
Második ébresztés, most erősebben, de a: Second wake-up, harder now, but keep the cadence at 100; then the opening is over.
Négy perc van a rajt előtt, lazítsd ki a: Four minutes before the start; loosen your shoulders, the three-minute test comes.

Egyenletesen, az utolsó percben mindent: Evenly, and give everything in the last minute.
